DESCRIPTION: Creates every warehouse table the other pipelines write: landing, history (PRS), change (CDC) and staging tables per client, the ODS and mart tables, and the reference copies. It creates a table only when it is missing and leaves existing tables as they are. Run it once after the project is published.

Copies the reference tables (agents, customer types, support areas, sources) and the data dictionary from the steward-maintained ds and info schemas into the warehouse as history, and marks the keys that no longer exist as deleted. A steward upload pipeline starts it after a reference change.

Loads Alpha's support interactions from MongoDB through landing, history (PRS), this run's changes (CDC) and the shared staging table, evaluates the business rules, and merges the rows into the ODS tables.

Loads Beta's support interactions from the Kafka topic client-beta through landing, history (PRS), this run's changes (CDC) and the shared staging table, evaluates the business rules, and merges the rows into the ODS tables.

Loads Gamma's support interactions from MinIO object events through landing, history (PRS), this run's changes (CDC), staging, the business rules and the ODS merges. It has no schedule: its first task waits for new objects without a time limit, and when a run ends successfully or is skipped the controller starts the next one at once (AUTO_RESTART_CONDITION).
A steward uploads a CSV of agents; it is validated, landed and merged into ds.agents, and SI_REFERENCE is started to refresh the warehouse copy.
A steward uploads a CSV of customer types; it is validated, landed and merged into ds.customer_types, and SI_REFERENCE is started to refresh the warehouse copy.
A steward uploads a CSV of support areas; it is validated, landed and merged into ds.support_areas, and SI_REFERENCE is started to refresh the warehouse copy.

A steward uploads business records (support interactions) as a CSV; after validation they follow the same path as a client's data: landing, history, changes, staging, business rules and the ODS merges.
Publishes the customer support fact mart from committed ODS changes. Each run reads only the rows changed since the last committed window and has no dependency on how fresh any one client is.
Nightly Iceberg maintenance of the warehouse schemas, one unmanaged script per schema. Run it only while no writer is active.
Creates the two reporting views over the mirrored audit tables and the ODS and mart tables. It has no schedule: run it after the first cloning cycle and after changing a view's SELECT.
